name: hds-mcp
description: Read and add to your Health Data Safe account, and import your own medical records from files on this computer.
long_description: The local Health Data Safe (HDS) server for your AI assistant: look up the HDS data model, read your account, add data, and import your own medical records from files on this computer after you check them on a page in your browser. For everyday use without files, the hosted HDS connector (a URL from your HDS account, AI assistant tab) needs no install. Signs in through your browser; connects to the HDS demo platform unless you ask for your real account.
